name: Anjou Kenta
source:
Faceless protagonist of the game.

Kenta moves in with his cousins, [url=/c17583]Maki[/url] and [url=/c17582]Saki[/url], so he can attend a nearby school. He has to do the chores around the house in return for not paying any rent.

When he was little he always played with his cousins.
